Subject: Lendwell security follow-up: DPA, SCC module and SOC 2 evidence

Hi Priya (and team),

Thanks again for taking time yesterday — appreciated the clear signal on risk priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call recap (short):
- Scope: Lendwell plans to use Redwood-hosted inference for loan-decisioning features (PII + financial data).
- Compliance drivers: GDPR role clarity for EU data flows, SOC 2 Type II evidence for procurement, and HIPAA considerations for a subset of medical claim data (if the use expands).
- Legal asks: a copy of our DPA, SCC module preference (you indicated Lendwell will likely be Controller), SOC 2 report, and kickoff of your security questionnaire.

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
1) We will share a DPA draft that identifies Redwood as the Processor and Lendwell as the Controller — attached is a starting draft (DPA_draft_lendwell_redwood_v1.docx). Please confirm if that aligns with your internal view.
2) Recommend using the Controller -> Processor SCC path for EU transfers (we can propose the appropriate module text). If Lendwell prefers a different SCC flavor, call that out and we can adapt.
3) I'll attach our redacted SOC 2 Type II attestation (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf) and we can provide a secure NDA'd folder for the full report if needed.
4) Please send over the security questionnaire (we saw the XLS referenced in procurement notes) and we'll populate it; if you prefer we start with our standard questionnaire export, we can do that as well.

Questions for you (to help us prepare before legal review):
- Final confirmation on controller vs processor roles across EU data and any downstream subprocessors you already know you'll require disclosure for.
- Any specific SCC module text you must use (your standard legal template or regulator-specific text).
- Target timeline for contract sign — is Lendwell aiming for a March in-contract date?

Attachments: DPA_draft_lendwell_redwood_v1.docx, Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf

If helpful, I can set a 30-min legal-to-legal sync next week (Marissa and Neha are copied) to walk through the redlines.

Best,
Rafael

Thanks Rafael — great summary. A few quick responses: 

- Role: Lendwell will be the Controller for customer data collected in the EU; Redwood will be Vendor/Processor. That matches our expectation from yesterday.
- SCC: our legal team prefers standard Controller-to-Processor clauses (we'll attach our preferred module).
- SOC 2: we need the full SOC 2 Type II report (redactions are acceptable). Please indicate how you prefer to share (SFTP vs NDAd Drive link).
- HIPAA: HIPAA applicability is conditional on whether we move forward with claims data. For now please include a HIPAA appendix option in the DPA.

I've attached the procurement security questionnaire (Lendwell_Security_Q_A.xlsx). Our security manager (security@lendwell.com) will take point on the questionnaire and follow up with any clarifying Qs.

Goal: legal wants a DPA draft + SCC alignment by early next week so they can circulate. Can you confirm you can provide both items by Monday EOD PST?

Best,
